Honest answer? The Eco Organic is fine — and for many people, it's more than fine.
Here's the real talk: Both mattresses share the same GOTS certification and nontoxic safety standards, so you're getting genuinely organic materials either way. The Eco Organic has up to 1,024 individually wrapped coils and GOLS-certified organic latex, which is solid construction for the price.

You want certified organic without stretching your budget
You're okay with one medium feel (no customization needed)
A 10-year warranty feels sufficient
You want to try it for 100 nights and move on
When the Green Mattress is worth the extra:
You're picky about firmness and want options (5 choices vs. 1)
You want a mattress that lasts decades — the Green has a 25-year warranty vs. 10 years, and organic mattresses last longer than synthetic ones anyway
